_readme: Release notes for /changelog. Add an entry here, newest or oldest anywhere: the page sorts by date. No code change needed. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; write each item as one plain sentence a customer would understand.

entries.title: Plans by request, legal pages and a resource library
items: Get Starter, Get Pro and Get Agency now open a contact page with your plan already chosen. We reply within one working day and set the plan up for you.
Published our Privacy policy and Terms of service, linked from the audit form and the contact form.
New Help centre, grouped by running an audit, reading a report, plans and billing, and your account and data.
New guides: UX laws explained, a WCAG 2.2 accessibility checklist and a printable UX audit template.
Six new articles on the blog: WCAG 2.2, colour contrast, tap target sizes, layout shift, heuristic evaluation, and what to do after a UX audit.

entries.title: The ProCurveUX blog and About page
items: Launched the blog with four articles on automated UX audits, real-browser testing, conversion and ADA website lawsuits.
Added author pages, so you can see who wrote each article and their background.
Added an About page explaining how an audit works and what it checks.
Rewrote the homepage to explain ProCurveUX in plainer words.

entries.title: ProCurveUX launches on procurveux.com
items: Choose one or more goals for an audit, and watch real progress while the page is scanned.
Your first audit is free with just your email address.
Reports export as a PDF without blank pages.
Links to a report show a preview image when shared.
Contact the team straight from the homepage.
